turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious and perfect for a hot day. You're always so good at keeping up with your vegetarian diet. Did you put anything special in it?

turns.text: Thanks! Yeah, keeping it vegetarian is pretty easy when you prep. I just tossed in some chickpeas, cucumbers, and a lemon vinaigrette.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Yum, that sounds incredibly refreshing. How is your roommate Sam doing? Are you two planning any rock climbing or guitar sessions this evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sam is doing great! We might actually climb tomorrow, but tonight I think I'm just going to relax and play some guitar.

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user
